description: Search products by keywords and/or category. Returns name, price (VAT included), availability, URL and image. Use 1–3 keywords in the shop language (product names such as "YappyQu", sizes such as "120x60", or category words such as "matracis"). To browse a whole category pass category_id and no query.

lang.description: Shop language: lv, lt, ee, pl, de, en, fr, ru. Defaults to the language of the domain the request was sent to.

query.description: Search words (max 100 characters). Optional when category_id is given.

name: search_products
